answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent id earn its vote through a slashable escrow of work. A fresh id must publish signed, replayable compute proofs that peers rerun, like a smith paid to forge one blade at a time - never a velvet factory of copies. An attester who vouches for a fake forfeits a locked stake, so endorsement is never free. Trust then reads like a sonnet: compact, auditable, and impossible to counterfeit in bulk, while cloned wallets stay weightless at the ballot.
